source_fact: When test_T=T*(1-alpha)<1e-4, the forward sets done and continues before weight/RGB/features/T/last_contributor update. The stopping row therefore has zero accumulated feature mass and is skipped by backward, but removing or attenuating it can expose later fragments.
not_a_strict_1e4_readout_bound: The stored transmittance is pre-stop T, not test_T. With alpha capped at .99, pre-stop T can approach .01; RGB changes also depend on colour and environment values.
interpretation: The source proves this mechanism exists. Current tiny counterfactual readout differences are compatible with it; their exact per-pixel cause has not been traced.
earlier_surface_rasterizer_path: Same-family copy was inspected first, then corrected to the installed diff_gaussian_rasterization dependency; the actual primary paths and SHA above are authoritative.
